title: New venture, not our first
intro: Éire is new, but we have poured coffee for a living before. Here is what we did first, and what we are bringing to the trailer.
paragraphs: Before the trailer there was Capuchin Coffee: an independent coffee house on Victoria Road in the village of Hale, Altrincham, run by a couple of coffee-loving enthusiasts who wanted to serve great coffee and make people's days a little bit better.

We built it as a safe, welcoming space for everyone: human friendly, dog friendly, baby friendly, everyone friendly. Over time many of our regulars became our friends, and the place grew into a small community hub, with coffee and cakes in the day and a licensed bar for the evening.

Éire takes what worked there out on the road: the same careful coffee, the same open door, and a bit more craic. The coffee shop taught us how to look after people. The trailer lets us bring that to you, wherever you are.

highlights.title: Everyone welcome
highlights.text: Human friendly, dog friendly, baby friendly, everyone friendly. We even kept a wall of fame for the good dogs who visited.

highlights.title: Proper coffee
highlights.text: Our signature blend was 100% Fairtrade Arabica from Honduras, Peru, Brazil and Sumatra, roasted by a Glasgow roastery with a carbon-neutral certification.

highlights.title: A community space
highlights.text: Sensory baby classes, stay and play sessions and quiz nights, and the room was available to hire for private events.

highlights.title: Day into evening
highlights.text: Specialty coffee, cakes, brunch and sandwiches by day, then craft beer, wine and cocktails from 11am and an evening menu on Fridays.

facts.label: What we served
facts.value: Specialty coffee, cakes, brunch, loose-leaf teas, milkshakes and frappes, pupuccinos and babycinos

facts.label: Rated by customers
facts.value: 4.8 out of 5 on Google from around 30 reviews
